## GOAL SEQUENCE (flagged: âœ… ready/done Â· âš ï¸ needs review/framing per agreement)
> RELEASE TARGET: route creation. The dedupe is the FOUNDATION it rides on (snap-2 needs clean trails+tracks). Order below reflects that.

**1. Cosmetic / quick-win pass** â€” shrink the list, lowest risk first.
- 1a. âœ… READY â€” Tier 1 cosmetic, ONE combined patch: dup AlertDialog import (ConvoyScreen.kt 34 & 85), Map Sources discoverability hint, remove old "Work with Tracks," trail-source intro text. Pure text/dead-import, no review needed.
- 1b. âœ… DONE â€” SAT/TOPO bar + North indicator + zoom readout. Completed.
- 1c. âœ… DONE â€” Tier 2 import/track-source cluster FIXED (GPX Y/N prompt, trailSourceCount=0, METHOD_SELECT/B1_DRAW_AREA). EXCEPTION: track-dedupe / existence-check pulled OUT of cosmetic and MERGED into goal 2.
- 1d. âš ï¸ NEEDS REVIEW â€” z12 hide-features (own patch/build). Touches viewport query path; device-check nothing vanishes wrongly at z11â†’z12.
- (Dropped: the `!!`/safe-call warning-tidy â€” compiler-warning cleanup only, no feature value, runtime risk, no clear purpose. Resurfaces only if a warning ever causes a real problem.)

**2. Dupe-creation roadblocks â€” UNIFIED across ALL FOUR ARTIFACTS â€” BUILD THE AUTOMATED SCRUB** â€” trust/usability blockers (FLAW items under SP12). **THIS IS THE FOUNDATION FOR ROUTE CREATION** (snap-2 snaps to trails+tracks; dupes = unreliable snapping). Product MUST ship with these fixes.

**â–¶ DAY-2 BUILD ORDER (start here): DB REVISIONS + DB RULES FIRST, then the dedupe rule.** Do all the schema work up front â€” UNIQUE constraints (trails + routes), alias tables/fields WITH the date column, source_id, the 'null'-naming fix. Getting the DB structure + rules right TIGHTENS THE EXISTING PROCESSES (import, capture, creation lean on structural guards instead of each carrying scattered checks), which then leaves just the DEDUPE RULE â€” the per-type detection logic â€” to apply on top. So: (1) DB revisions + DB rules (schema, constraints, dated alias tables, source_id, naming fix) â†’ (2) the per-type dedupe detection rule riding on the now-solid schema. This fits the scrubâ†’constraint ordering dependency: the DB work is where that lives.

**THE GUIDING PRINCIPLE (elegantly simple): "My data is my data; everybody else's data is an alias."** Anything you authored is primary; anything arriving from elsewhere attaches as an alias. Never overwrites anyone. Every rule below follows from this.

**THE UNIFIED RULE (all four artifacts â€” trails, tracks, waypoints, routes):**
  - **Same name + same geometry â†’ REMOVE** (true duplicate).
  - **New name + same geometry â†’ ALIAS** (keep original + name, attach the new name; no second row).
Same OUTCOME logic everywhere. What differs is only the DETECTION basis per type (below).

**ALIAS RECORD CARRIES A DATE (added 2026-05-31).** An alias is not a bare name â€” it is a small record: (name + date [+ likely source/who]). The DATE enforces the AWS same-day rule: when a same-geometry contribution arrives, check "already an alias for this geometry on this date?" â†’ YES = skip; NO = add the dated alias. Alias uniqueness key = (geometry + date): ONE alias per geometry per day. Concrete SCHEMA requirement â€” the alias table/field must include a date.

**NAMES ARE LOCAL-PRIMARY â€” first-occurrence model, NOT a replicated DB (clarified 2026-05-31).** The AWS store is a FIRST-OCCURRENCE database, not a mirror of everyone's data. Local devices are NOT forced to match AWS.
  - YOUR name stays YOURS. A route you made as "abc" on your device STAYS "abc" â€” your name, never overwritten. The same physical route may already be known as "def" on AWS (someone got there first). That's fine; "abc" remains your authoritative local name.
  - Aliasing accumulates INWARD, at insert. When you pull an AWS route DOWN and it inserts into your local DB, the AWS name ("def") becomes an ALIAS in your DB; your "abc" stays primary. Whichever side pulls, the incoming name attaches as an alias; the local/first name stays authoritative on that side.
  - So there's no central "canonical name" forced on anyone â€” each side keeps its own primary name and accumulates the others' names as aliases.

**MANUAL vs AUTOMATED â€” the core of this goal:** the 82,220â†’42,451 trail cleanup was a ONE-TIME MANUAL scrub on the PC. That does NOT exist in the product. What must be BUILT is an AUTOMATED dedupe for ALL FOUR artifact types.
**DECISION (resolved 2026-05-31): the local scrub runs ONE TIME DURING INSTALL.** Not every-launch, not a route-build precursor. Clean once, correctly, so by the time route creation runs the data is already clean. (Lowest runtime cost; keeps work off the already-troubled startup path.)
**TWO-LAYER ARCHITECTURE (agreed):**
  - **Layer 1 â€” install scrub (one-time cleanup of what's there):** apply the unified rule to existing data; fix 'null'/unnamed-trail naming so unnamed trails dedupe correctly on geometry. Contamination eliminated before route creation runs.
  - **Layer 2 â€” DB-level guard (permanent prevention):** for trails (and routes â€” see below), the check is a DATABASE FEATURE â€” UNIQUE(name, geometry) + INSERT OR IGNORE. DB structurally refuses duplicates; NOT scattered app-layer checks.
**ORDERING DEPENDENCY:** dedupe existing data FIRST, THEN add the UNIQUE constraint (can't constrain a table that still has dupes â€” migration fails). Order = scrub â†’ then constraint.

**ARTIFACT-SPECIFIC DETECTION (four types; unified outcome, per-type detection):**
- **TRAILS â†’ COLLAPSE.** Detect = same (name, geometry). Duplicate dropped. DB-expressible (UNIQUE).
- **TRACKS â†’ ALIAS.** Detect = same GEOMETRY (path). Name varies by ride/day; name-equality is just a SKIP shortcut. (1) same name â†’ SKIP; (2) diff name same geometry â†’ ALIAS (dominant case â€” same trail, different rides/days). Import AND DBG capture.
- **WAYPOINTS â†’ ALIAS by PROXIMITY.** Single points never share exact coords (GPS drift). Detect = within distance threshold + same real feature â†’ ALIAS. Same outcome as tracks, proximity detection. Import AND DBG capture / waypoint creation.
  - âš ï¸ FRAMING (waypoints): proximity THRESHOLD (50m? 100m?) and does TYPE gate the match (two trailheads alias; trailhead vs nearby water source do NOT)? User judgment at framing.
- **ROUTES â†’ SAME DB RULES.** Detect = same geometry (a path, like trails/tracks). Same name+geometry â†’ remove; new name+same geometry â†’ alias. DB-expressible like trails. **SCALE FACTOR:** routes are created by MULTIPLE INDIVIDUALS and ACCUMULATE in AWS as a FIRST-OCCURRENCE store (see local-primary note above). Many people create essentially the same route, named differently. First occurrence holds AWS's name; when others pull it down, AWS's name becomes a local alias while their own name stays primary. Routes get the rule at TWO locations: local DB (UNIQUE like trails) AND the AWS first-occurrence store.
  - **AWS SAME-DAY RULE (added 2026-05-31): two rides with the same geometry on the same day â†’ add only ONE alias.** A group rides the same trail together; many riders' devices capture the same geometry the same day and all push to AWS. Without this, one ride spams the store with N aliases. The rule collapses the same-geometry/same-day cluster to a SINGLE alias contribution. One ride = one alias, even if ten people captured it. ENFORCED VIA the dated alias record (above): alias uniqueness key (geometry + date), so a second same-geometry contribution on the same date finds an existing alias and skips.
    - âš ï¸ FRAMING: define "same day" â€” calendar day vs time window (group straggling past midnight; or two independent riders same calendar day â€” arguably still one alias since same route). Set alongside the route geometry-match tolerance. AWS-side enforcement is a distinct location from the local install scrub â€” frame both.
- âš ï¸ FRAMING (tracks + waypoints + routes): implies an alias field/table on tracks, waypoints, AND routes, and that record CARRIES A DATE (for the one-alias-per-day rule). Confirm alias storage shape per type.

**ARTIFACT-DETAIL PANEL = PART OF GOAL 2 (added 2026-05-31).** The alias work is NOT done until the UI can show and manage aliases â€” a schema full of aliases nobody can see is half a feature. The artifact detail/info panel (the rename / share / etc. panel) needs, driven by the aliasing model:
  - **(A) An ALIAS-NAME ACCORDION** â€” primary name on top; the accordion expands to reveal the alias names (the dated alias records) others have given the same artifact. Your name is primary; aliases listed beneath.
  - **(B) A FULL-DATA DESCRIPTION CARD** â€” a card showing the COMPLETE artifact data/description: the SAME data you'd see in the map-tap info popup "if you happen to land on it just right." The panel makes that full info reliably available instead of depending on a precise map tap.
  - Plus existing actions (rename, share, etc.). So the panel = primary name + alias accordion + full-data card + actions.
  - This is the UI COMPLETION of goal 2 (depends on the alias data existing first), not a separate effort.

**IMPORT RULES = DEFERRED (do not over-specify now).** Detailed rules for IMPORTING â€” areas, trails, routes, waypoints â€” get discussed WHEN WE GET THERE. User expects SIMPLE, PRAGMATIC rules. Captured principle only: pull AWS â†’ on insert into local DB, the incoming AWS name becomes a LOCAL ALIAS (local name stays primary). Full import ruleset is a later framing topic, not for goal-2 build.

Principle: do NOT keep ADDING any of the four without eliminating dupes + the existence check first. Same scrub mechanism, per-type detection (collapse trails; alias tracks by geometry; alias waypoints by proximity; alias routes by geometry, local + AWS):
- 2a. dupe-identification â€” trails: (name, geometry) collapse; tracks: geometry â†’ alias (name = skip); waypoints: proximity (+ maybe type) â†’ alias; routes: geometry â†’ alias (same name+geom = remove).
- 2b. install-time dedupe pass (automatic, can't be skipped) â€” all four locally.
- 2c. existence-check = DB feature (UNIQUE + INSERT OR IGNORE) for trails AND routes; tracks/waypoints aliasing is app-logic at insert/capture (geometry-similarity/proximity can't be a simple UNIQUE column).
- 2d. DB-level UNIQUE(name, geometry) on trails + routes â€” applied AFTER the scrub (ordering dependency).
- 2e. add source_id; fix 'null'/unnamed naming (so geometry-based dedupe works for unnamed trails).
- 2f. tracks: name+alias rule. waypoints: proximity+alias rule. routes: geometry alias rule (local + AWS, first-occurrence/local-primary names). Alias record carries a DATE. ALL in import AND DBG capture / creation as applicable.
- 2g. ROUTES at AWS: first-occurrence store; when pulled down, AWS name â†’ local alias, local name stays primary (NOT a forced canonical name). Same geometry + same day = ONE alias (alias key = geometry + date; don't multiply aliases for one group ride).
- 2h. ARTIFACT-DETAIL PANEL (UI completion): alias-name accordion + full-data description card + existing rename/share actions. Surfaces the alias data + the same full info as the map-tap popup. Part of goal 2.
- âš ï¸ NEEDS FRAMING â€” big issue. Surface TrailArchitecture_v2; reference + adjust together before cutting. # GroupTrack â€” Version 2.5 Release Notes (What's New)
_Field Test Release Â· Map Feature Update Â· updated 2026-05-31_

## About this release
V2.5 completes the free map product: trail and trailhead data you can download straight onto your maps, plus a single, consistent way to show and hide Trails, Tracks, Waypoints, and Routes on both the Convoy Map and the Planning Map. FIELD TEST build â€” known rough edges listed at the end.

## Headline: Import Utah Trails Onto Your Map
The big addition is the trail source catalog â€” pull a full set of Utah trails + trailhead waypoints directly onto your maps as artifacts, no files to copy, no internet needed once down.

**How to import UGRC Utah Trails:**
1. Open Work with Artifacts (accordion button).
2. Select Import Trails. The trail source list displays.
3. Select UGRC Utah Trails.
4. Tap Validate/Confirm. Trails + trailhead waypoints download as artifacts.
5. Fully close the app, force close, reopen. Imported trails/trailheads now appear.

**If imported trails don't show:** (1) Fully close/reopen (or Force Stop) so trail data loads. (2) Zoom in â€” ~49,000 trails only draw at close zoom. Intentional (see Known Issues).

## What Else Is New
- **Trail source catalog** â€” browse + import. UGRC Utah Trails first (~49,000 trails + 591 trailheads). BLM/USFS planned.
- **One consistent artifact display** â€” Trails/Tracks/Waypoints/Routes show + hide the same way on both maps via one shared process.
- **Independent map selections (NEW)** â€” Convoy and Planning maps each keep their OWN selections, saved across restarts. No longer carries between maps.
- **SELECTED shows exactly what you pick (NEW)** â€” SELECTED draws only checked items, consistent on both maps.
- **Drop waypoints on the map (NEW)** â€” long-press empty ground â†’ 12 types (hazard, gate, water, fuel, shelter, trailhead, viewpoint, campsite, parking, junction, rally, other) + optional name. Appears on both maps.
- **Work with Artifacts panel** â€” accordion; per-type ON/OFF/SELECTED + item list.
- **Default on launch** â€” Trails ON, others OFF.
- **RESYNC TRACKS** â€” rebuilds track list from saved GPX.
- **Zoom readout** â€” compass shows zoom level (N Â· Z##).
- **Standalone GPS / offline maps** â€” carried from V2.4.

## Requirements
- Android 8.0+ (tablet recommended). Auto-update via Play Store internal track. 500MB+ free for tiles (trail data ~15â€“30MB/state). Meshtastic SenseCAP T1000-E or LoRa fw 2.6+ (only for convoy, not maps). Internet needed once to import/download.

## Known Issues â€” Please Read
- **Trails not visible zoomed far out** â€” expected; zoom in. Clean cutoff being finalized.
- **Item list sometimes shows no names** â€” known; being addressed.
- **Don't import the same trails/tracks repeatedly** â€” re-import can add duplicates (dedupe check coming). Import UGRC ONCE; use RESYNC TRACKS if something looks off.
- **Tracks missing after update** â€” RESYNC TRACKS rebuilds.

**Resolved since last build:** map selections are now independent per map and saved â€” the earlier "selections carry between maps" behavior is FIXED.

## Troubleshooting
- Imported trails don't appear â†’ zoom in; confirm import finished.
- No vehicles (convoy) â†’ radio connected (green)? same channel + PSK?
- Tiles blank offline â†’ download tiles while online first.
- Tiles not loading online â†’ check internet.
- Track missing â†’ RESYNC TRACKS.
- Anything else â†’ report it (note what you tapped + expected).
